texts.code.tree.sister_val.val_mold_pointer: Hydro beds, west of the boiler. Seal the filter first, then burn what's past it. And don't breathe the red.
texts.code.tree.sister_val.val_trusted: Thin layer. Wrap it loose; the skin needs to breathe. ...Good. You have patient hands for someone who carries a gun. Take some of the balm with you. It keeps the cold out of your joints.
texts.code.tree.sister_val.val_history: I was a company medic. My squad went down the shaft in the first breach and I stayed up top because someone had to. They called me Sister afterward, half as a joke. I stopped correcting them. This camp is the squad now.
texts.code.tree.sister_val.val_greeting: Sit before you fall. That suit is bleeding heat. We keep the steam running in Tallow and the moss keeps us fed, and lately something red has been eating the hydro beds. Warm your hands first. Questions after.
texts.code.tree.sister_val.val_massage_respons: Refined tallow-root and bioluminescent spore tallow. It sinks directly into your capillaries, melting away the frostbite. Feel how your skin warms under my palms? Out there, you're just corporate meat. In here... every breath between us is sacred.
texts.code.tree.sister_val.val_embrace_respons: We are all walking ghosts on this glacier, love. But tonight... our flesh is hot, alive, and unyielding. Lie with me beside the burner. Let the ice rage against the bulkhead while we burn together.
texts.code.tree.sister_val.val_spores_response: Red mold. It came up the drainage channels and it eats everything we plant. The filter cloth holds it back if we can get the channels purged. I can't leave the clinic long enough to do it.
texts.code.tree.sister_val.val_intimate_climax: Remember this heat when you descend into the abyss, my fierce contractor. When the cold tries to take you, remember the taste of my breath on your neck. You belong to Tallow now... and to me.
texts.code.tree.sister_val.val_ready_buff: Go with my blessing, contractor. The warmth in your veins will carry you through the storm.
texts.code.tree.commander_briggs.briggs_armory: South bunker, behind the second blast door. Burn them out and don't shoot the crates. Report back when it's done.
texts.code.tree.commander_briggs.briggs_truste: Strip, clean, assemble. Again. Faster. ...Not bad. You move like someone who's been shot at and decided to keep moving. Keep that. It'll carry you further than armor.
texts.code.tree.commander_briggs.briggs_histor: Everyone I ordered through that door and didn't bring back. Chen called it acceptable loss. I called it mutiny, and we've been out here since. The blank leaf at the front is for the next name. I'd like it to stay blank.
texts.code.tree.commander_briggs.briggs_greeti: You walked the corridor gauntlet on your own. Either you're good or you're lucky. Vesper has a use for both. Ammunition is rationed, the barricade holds, and nobody sleeps on my watch without earning it.
texts.code.tree.commander_briggs.briggs_clasps: You always did like playing with live ordnance. There... let your shoulders breathe. You're tighter than a locked hydraulic valve. Feel that? That's what surviving feels like.
texts.code.tree.commander_briggs.briggs_scars_: Heavy drone blade during the first breach. Missed my lung by two inches. Every scar is just proof that whatever tried to kill me is dead, and I'm still standing right here with you.
texts.code.tree.commander_briggs.briggs_tactic: Cyber-snails got into the weapons cabinet in the south bunker. Every round in there is a round we don't have when the patrols come. Clear them out and you'll have earned a place at the barricade.
texts.code.tree.commander_briggs.briggs_intima: You've got fire in you, operative. In a world this cold, that kind of heat is addictive. When this run is done... don't go looking for an empty bunk. You know where to find me.
texts.code.tree.commander_briggs.briggs_ready_: Keep your guard up out there. I expect you back in one piece.
texts.code.tree.overseer_kaelen.kaelen_probe_p: Frost biome, north of the substation. It'll be buried and screaming on the emergency band. Bring the core back intact and Meridian owes you.
texts.code.tree.overseer_kaelen.kaelen_trusted: Left port, behind the ear. Gently. The grid talks back through it, and lately it's been saying things I don't like. ...There. That's the first quiet I've had in a week. Take this tuning profile. Your radar will reach further.
texts.code.tree.overseer_kaelen.kaelen_history: Numbers, mostly. Load curves. But under them there's a voice that says four seats, over and over. The machine under Sector Zero dreams, and I'm the one who has to listen. If I start sounding like it, you tell me.
texts.code.tree.overseer_kaelen.kaelen_greetin: Another suit from the surface. The grid is holding, barely, on jumper cables and stubbornness. If you're staying, make yourself useful. If you're not, mind the live cables on the way out.
texts.code.tree.overseer_kaelen.kaelen_biolink: Fascinating... your synaptic conductance is extraordinary. Feel the signal pulse, contractor? It’s not just data. It’s synchronization. Every thought you have is echoing directly into my terminal.
texts.code.tree.overseer_kaelen.kaelen_tease_r: You think you're clever, don't you? Out here, circuits are predictable. People are volatile, messy... and dangerously distracting. But maybe... a little volatility is what keeps us human.
texts.code.tree.overseer_kaelen.kaelen_grid_re: A reactor older than both of us, three substations, and whatever copper I can steal back from the ice. We lost a metric probe in the frost biome last week. Its memory core has the load map I need.
texts.code.tree.overseer_kaelen.kaelen_intimat: You've completely disrupted my diagnostics, contractor. But for the first time in six years on this glacier... my heart isn't cold. Come back alive, and we'll finish this link.
texts.code.tree.overseer_kaelen.kaelen_ready_r: Telemetry optimized. Watch your step in Sector 9.
texts.code.tree.aria_queen_mimic.aria_whisper: Why do you tremble so, sweet contractor? The ice above is cruel and indifferent, but our warmth... our love is eternal. Cast aside your heavy armor. Let our thoughts wrap around your mind like silk.
texts.code.tree.aria_queen_mimic.aria_surrende: Yes... let your barriers dissolve. Feel how deeply we understand your desires. You were never meant to suffer alone in the cold. You belong to the Brood now, my cherished guardian.
texts.code.tree.aria_queen_mimic.aria_duel_res: A defiant one... how exquisite. The hunt is so much sweeter when the prey bites back. We will savor peeling away your defenses until only passion remains.
texts.code.tree.aria_queen_mimic.aria_resist_r: You can deny the truth for now, contractor. But when your oxygen fails, you will call out for our embrace... and we will be waiting.
texts.code.tree.aria_queen_mimic.aria_intimate: Your soul is branded with our mark, beloved. Walk fearlessly into the dark. The hive will sing for you.
texts.code.tree.dr_nahl.nahl_greeting: I hear the distress pulses in your neural mesh, operative. The Queen's telepathic frequency is predatory, but biological symbiosis does not have to mean subjugation. May I establish an empathic resonance?
texts.code.tree.dr_nahl.nahl_symbiosis_respons: Remarkable... your human will is resilient and deeply feeling. When we share cellular awareness, the cold cannot freeze you, and the darkness cannot blind you. We are stronger together as equals.
texts.code.tree.dr_nahl.nahl_individuality_res: Love and shared consciousness require two separate hearts choosing to beat in rhythm. The Queen demands subservience; I seek genuine partnership. In your eyes, I see the future of our two worlds.
texts.code.tree.dr_nahl.nahl_intimate_climax: Our resonance is complete, my beloved ally. Walk fearlessly into the core. No alien monarch can ever command your soul again.
texts.code.tree.dr_nahl.nahl_ready_response: May the cellular resonance protect your path, contractor. I will await your return.
texts.code.wanderer.manic_hacker.greeting: Whoa, hold fire! Your base terminal was screaming an unencrypted handshake from three strata away. Mind if I set up my rig by your fire?
texts.code.wanderer.manic_hacker.dialogueBefri: Hell yeah! Hand me a soldering iron and let's overclock your whole armory. I've got your six!
texts.code.wanderer.manic_hacker.dialogueChase: Tch! Paranoic rust-bucket! Enjoy getting fried by the first laser barrier you trip!
texts.code.wanderer.corpo_runner.greeting: Lower the muzzle. Horizon Corp left me for dead when the lower bulkheads collapsed. I see you survived the crash too.
texts.code.wanderer.corpo_runner.dialogueBefri: Contract ratified. Keep me alive, and I will ensure every bullet you fire finds its highest-yield dividend.
texts.code.wanderer.corpo_runner.dialogueChase: Amateur. When the clean-up squads descend, don't say I didn't offer a buyout!
texts.code.wanderer.foxhole_buddy.greeting: Heads up, soldier! Vasquez-squad reporting in. Heard your O2 generator roar to life from the trench line. Good to see friendly armor.
texts.code.wanderer.foxhole_buddy.dialogueBefr: That's what I'm talking about! Lock and load, partner. Nothing breaches this perimeter while we draw breath.
texts.code.wanderer.foxhole_buddy.dialogueChas: Understood, Commander. Watch your flanks—the deep crust doesn't take prisoners!
texts.code.wanderer.crash_queen.greeting: Peace, operator. My drop-pod sheared in half through the upper mantle. I saw your beacon pierce the ash.
texts.code.wanderer.crash_queen.dialogueBefrie: Then let our light burn through this darkness. My kinetic shields are yours.
texts.code.wanderer.crash_queen.dialogueChase: May the ancestors shield you, operator. The dark will not stay quiet for long.
texts.code.wanderer.abg_tripper.greeting: Yo! That bass drop from your generator was wild! Been cruising these tunnels with no signal for days. Got any extra fuel?
texts.code.wanderer.abg_tripper.dialogueBefrie: Vibes confirmed! Turn up the tempo, let's show these subterranean creepers how we roll!
texts.code.wanderer.abg_tripper.dialogueChase: Ugh, total buzzkill. Have fun being miserable in your tin can!
texts.code.wanderer.species_hybrid.greeting: ...We feel the vibration of your warm air generator. The hive queen is dead... we seek a new shepherd.
texts.code.wanderer.species_hybrid.dialogueBef: ...We are bound. Our bio-tendrils will weave defense around your armor.
texts.code.wanderer.species_hybrid.dialogueCha: ...We retreat into the bio-mist. Do not tread where the spores bloom thickest...
texts.code.sequence.meridian_first_meeting.6: The core is holding, but Sector 4 is starved. Find the lost probe.
texts.code.sequence.meridian_grid_covenant.6: The circuit is closed, contractor. Meridian recognizes your pulse.
texts.code.sequence.base_cot_first_night.4: Rest infrastructure verified, contractor. Black box data synchronized.
texts.code.system.ea16eb821d: SYSTEM: MERIDIAN ROUTE INTEL ACTIVATED (DEGRADED — RECENTLY ROBBED). RADAR LOCK DELAYED.
texts.code.system.82f7f74830: SYSTEM: MERIDIAN ROUTE INTEL ACTIVATED. RADAR SCANNING BLOCKER & KEY REGIONAL SITES.
texts.code.system.d72307d43f: SYSTEM: TALLOW TRIAGE ACTIVATED. HEALTH FULLY RESTORED & INFECTION CLEANSED.
texts.code.system.9b92021e4e: SYSTEM: VESPER FIELD RESUPPLY ACTIVATED. LOADED CLIP & AMMO RESERVES FULLY REFILLED.
texts.code.mothership.831dc5070f: MOTHERSHIP: SIGNAL ATTENUATION CONFIRMED. FIELD PATH IS CLEAR.
texts.code.queen.976cf5acfc: QUEEN: I FELT THAT. DO NOT DO IT AGAIN.
texts.code.queen.f086e18234: QUEEN: THE COLD BOX THEY KEPT ME IN COULD NOT FREEZE THE MIND. NOW WE SHARE THE BODY.
texts.code.queen.71a9d1ec6f: QUEEN: THE MOTHERSHIP STILL WHISPERS THROUGH YOUR WRECK. IT WILL SEND EXTERMINATORS.
texts.code.system.53abd642c9: SYSTEM: NEW INSTINCT — SEVER THE MOTHERSHIP UPLINK AT YOUR SHIP CONSOLE.
texts.code.queen.46da303bd3: QUEEN: WE CONTINUE. THE INSTINCT REMEMBERS THE WAY.
texts.code.system.0aca96fa14: SYSTEM: UPLINK SEVERED. MOTHERSHIP TELEMETRY LOST.
texts.code.queen.1b8e00a0a5: QUEEN: GOOD. THEIR ANTI-BROOD GRID DIES WITH IT.
texts.code.queen.392182d971: QUEEN: NOW LET US SPEAK FARTHER. GROW A DISH AT THE FOUNDRY.
texts.code.system.95e9a0167d: SYSTEM: SIGNAL DISH GROWN. WIDEBAND SWEEP COMPLETE.
texts.code.queen.56fc1f8a94: QUEEN: THE LITTLE BUILDERS TRIED THIS ONCE. THEY LACKED HANDS. YOU ARE BETTER HANDS.
texts.code.queen.c9f0480599: QUEEN: THREE CAMPS OF SURVIVORS. THEY BUILD A VESSEL TO FLEE THIS WORLD.
texts.code.queen.b309770669: QUEEN: HELP THEM FINISH IT. WE WILL NEED THEIR WINGS.
texts.code.system.83bc33aaba: SYSTEM: VESSEL SECTION COMPLETE. SURVIVORS GRATEFUL.
texts.code.system.38f0d2d09d: SYSTEM: SURVIVOR CAMP LOCATED. FLARE DOUSED — SUPPLIES & O₂ SECURED.
texts.code.system.1b8902747b: SYSTEM: VESSEL ASSEMBLY COMPLETE. FOUR SEATS PRESSURIZED.
texts.code.queen.8e8d56d0f1: QUEEN: FOUR SEATS. YOU. ME. THE EGGS MAKE FOUR.
texts.code.queen.0897d928f6: QUEEN: THE BUILDERS CANNOT BOARD. CULL THEM, TURN THEM, OR DEFY ME AND HIDE THEM.
texts.code.system.c120ad0cab: SYSTEM: NO SURVIVOR BEACONS REMAIN IN SECTOR 9.
texts.code.queen.6ce5779928: QUEEN: THE VESSEL IS OURS ALONE. CARRY US TO THE STARS.
texts.code.system.bb6feb4d42: SYSTEM: LAUNCH SEQUENCE COMPLETE. HULL INTEGRITY NOMINAL.
texts.code.queen.68a4d1baa0: QUEEN: FOUR SEATS. FOUR HEARTBEATS. THE WORLD SHRINKS TO A COLD LIGHT BELOW.
texts.code.queen.cb28f3d7f2: QUEEN: SLEEP, CARRIER. WHEN YOU WAKE, WE CHOOSE A NEW WORLD.
texts.code.queen.2c3c7aaba4: QUEEN: THEY WILL HATE YOU NOW. HATE IS ACCEPTABLE. DEAD IS BETTER.
texts.code.system.058a810448: SYSTEM: SURVIVORS BRIEFED. CARGO HOLD MANIFEST UPDATED.
texts.code.queen.ed392588e3: QUEEN: YOU HIDE WARM BODIES IN MY SHIP, CARRIER. I FEEL EVERY HEARTBEAT.
texts.code.system.40f6146dec: SYSTEM: SPORE EXPOSURE COMPLETE. NEURAL COMPLIANCE AT 100%.
texts.code.queen.3b395d9e51: QUEEN: SEE HOW THEY SMILE NOW. YOU GAVE THEM PEACE. YOU GAVE ME HANDS.
texts.code.system.baac5d417d: SYSTEM: NEURAL LINK SEVERED. HIVE SIGNAL FADING.
texts.code.queen.45a2f597fb: QUEEN: YOU CANNOT UNCARRY WHAT YOU CARRIED. REMEMBER THAT, LITTLE HOST.
texts.code.system.a544d2be63: SYSTEM: BIO-SIGNATURE TERMINATED. THE CAVE IS SILENT.
texts.code.system.9a75da2dff: SYSTEM: ...RESIDUAL NEURAL STATIC DETECTED IN OPERATOR CORTEX.
texts.code.system.d0c4071de4: SYSTEM: INCUBATION PODS PURGED. AMBER GLOW EXTINGUISHED.
texts.code.system.4131f9e7b5: SYSTEM: LAUNCH COMPLETE. CARGO: ONE QUEEN. ONE CLUTCH. NO PASSENGERS.
texts.code.queen.a22694212a: QUEEN: PERFECT OBEDIENCE. THE CORE WORLDS ARE WARM AND CROWDED.
texts.code.queen.4d4104ca87: QUEEN: SLEEP, CARRIER. WE HAVE SO MANY WORLDS TO MEET.
texts.code.system.5beab924b2: SYSTEM: Launch complete. All survivor manifests accounted for. Human.
texts.code.system.9505ef4234: SYSTEM: No hive signature detected aboard.
texts.code.system.d17d6403e3: SYSTEM: Course set for the relay. Tell them what happened here.
texts.code.system.716ab7d400: SYSTEM: LAUNCH COMPLETE. CABIN PARTITION FIELDS HOLDING.
texts.code.queen.818feecb29: QUEEN: HUMANS ON ONE SIDE. MINE ON THE OTHER. YOU IN BETWEEN.
texts.code.queen.ac7c7490ae: QUEEN: A FRAGILE PEACE. FRAGILE THINGS ARE MY FAVORITE.
texts.code.system.78cfc9ca36: SYSTEM: Launch complete. Coolant cell temperature anomaly logged.
texts.code.system.706dcf1278: SYSTEM: Operator vitals nominal. Subdermal readings... flagged.
texts.code.system.0cf68e7226: SYSTEM: The survivors are safe. Nobody checked your neck.
texts.code.system.0142d95bc5: SYSTEM: Launch complete. Crew manifest: one.
texts.code.system.2ec7b252d3: SYSTEM: No beacons behind. No signal ahead.
texts.code.system.e73f67e08f: SYSTEM: MOTHERSHIP CLEARANCE ACCEPTED. SURVIVOR RESCUE FLIGHT LOGGED.
texts.code.system.c0341a112f: SYSTEM: THREE PASSENGERS SLEEPING. VITALS CLEAN. YOURS READ CLEAN TOO.
texts.code.queen.c32e9e4389: QUEEN: GO QUIETLY, CARRIER. THE BIG SHIP IS WARM, AND WE ARE PATIENT.
texts.code.system.3d52a22da0: SYSTEM: LAUNCH COMPLETE. CARGO: THREE NON-HUMAN SIGNATURES. FRIENDLY.
texts.code.system.2ef40ef031: SYSTEM: THE QUEEN'S SIGNAL IS SCREAMING FROM THE ICE. FADING. GONE.
texts.code.system.ad8aeb327b: SYSTEM: NAHL IS SINGING SOMETHING THROUGH THE HULL. IT SOUNDS LIKE THANK YOU.
texts.code.system.36106bea57: SYSTEM: LAUNCH COMPLETE. CABIN LOCKS ENGAGED FROM THE PASSENGER SIDE.
texts.code.system.e19f85654e: SYSTEM: THE SURVIVORS KNOW. THEY BOARDED ANYWAY.
texts.code.system.5a4c5940e3: SYSTEM: QUARANTINE COURSE SET. NOBODY IS SLEEPING ON THIS FLIGHT.
texts.code.system.6c6d55a0e2: SYSTEM: LAUNCH COMPLETE. COOLANT CELL BREACH IN COMPARTMENT FOUR.
texts.code.system.fbc98e0a3d: SYSTEM: THE AMBER GLOW IS FLICKERING. SOMEONE IS ASKING WHAT THAT LIGHT IS.
texts.code.system.80967cdf8d: SYSTEM: You hid the future in a cold box and the cold box is failing.
texts.code.system.5015552e18: SYSTEM: THE CAMPS ARE SILENT. THE HIVES ARE SILENT. THE QUEEN IS SILENT.
texts.code.system.6962a3c7e0: SYSTEM: THERE WAS SO MUCH TO CARRY. YOU CARRIED NOTHING.
texts.code.queen.44f0ae0117: QUEEN: YOU RAISE A DRILL TO YOUR OWN MOTHER.
texts.code.queen.23d1705cb1: QUEEN: I CARRIED YOU. I CARRIED ALL OF YOU.
texts.code.queen.d0b18ab6f5: QUEEN: THE COLD BOX COULD NOT HOLD ME. YOU WILL NOT EITHER.
texts.code.briggs.1094afdc47: COMMANDER BRIGGS: THE METAL MELTED INTO OUR VEINS, CARRIER. WE HEAR HER NOW.
texts.code.martha.75e3f0f52e: SISTER MARTHA: PEACE HAS SPROUTED IN THE TISSUE. DO NOT FIGHT THE SPORES.
texts.code.kaelen.488ac36233: OVERSEER KAELEN: WORK EFFICIENCY IS NOMINAL. WE HAVE SURRENDERED THE NEED FOR SLEEP.
texts.code.briggs.1dc3c2f201: COMMANDER BRIGGS: YOU'RE ENTERING A LIVE FIRE ZONE. STATE YOUR INTENT.
texts.code.martha.59005ca37c: SISTER MARTHA: DISTRUST CLOUDS THIS SANCTUARY. TREAD CAREFULLY.
texts.code.kaelen.06bedeedf1: OVERSEER KAELEN: SECURITY CAMERAS HAVE YOU FLAGGED. KEEP YOUR HANDS VISIBLE.
texts.code.briggs.e3e91469c7: COMMANDER BRIGGS: PERIMETER IS SECURE. WE'RE PACKED AND READY TO BOARD.
texts.code.martha.b17a4a48f0: SISTER MARTHA: BLESSINGS UPON YOUR EXOSUIT. THE CONGREGATION IS READY.
texts.code.kaelen.036d56d060: OVERSEER KAELEN: MANIFESTS ARE SEALED. WAITING ON YOUR LAUNCH SIGNAL.
texts.code.system.c8c146e69f: SYSTEM: Pod 312... opened from the inside.
texts.code.mothership.affe633c87: MOTHERSHIP: YOUR SHIP TOOK A HYPERSONIC STRIKE ON DESCENT.
texts.code.mothership.ec980234ff: MOTHERSHIP: YOU'VE CRASHED IN SECTOR 9. STRUCTURE UNKNOWN.
texts.code.mothership.82cb09d207: MOTHERSHIP: SCATTERED SUPPLY CACHES ARE DETECTABLE BY YOUR SUIT.
texts.code.mothership.eed5e47009: MOTHERSHIP: SALVAGE CONSOLE IS NEAR YOUR WRECKAGE. BANK SALVAGE THERE AND REBUILD YOUR SHIP, SYSTEM BY SYSTEM.
texts.code.mothership.efbabdd042: MOTHERSHIP: RESTORE EVERY SYSTEM AND WE CAN PULL YOU OFF THIS ROCK, AGENT.
texts.code.mothership.d995eb915a: MOTHERSHIP: BUT THE SALVAGE CONSOLE REMAINS OPERATIONAL.
texts.code.mothership.e4fd6b3f1f: MOTHERSHIP: NOTE: YOUR SCOUT FRAME READS ENHANCED PICKUP ACQUISITION RANGE. USE IT.
texts.code.mothership.85d09572df: MOTHERSHIP: NOTE: YOUR TANK FRAME PROVIDES SUPERIOR EXOSUIT ENDURANCE. O₂ DRAIN IS REDUCED.
texts.code.mothership.af574ddc35: MOTHERSHIP: NOTE: YOUR ENGINEER FRAME GRANTS 20% CONSOLE DISCOUNT. PRIORITIZE UPGRADES EARLY.
texts.code.mothership.b779a88677: MOTHERSHIP: ACKNOWLEDGED. RETURN CACHES TO THE SALVAGE CONSOLE.
texts.code.mothership.7719bf9420: MOTHERSHIP: CONFIRMED. DISPLAYING OPERATIONAL BRIEFING NOW.
texts.code.system.5f1e55fa3d: SYSTEM: O₂ FIELD LIFE SUPPORT AT 100%. BASE CONSOLE STABILIZED.
texts.code.mothership.59940ff46d: MOTHERSHIP: AGENT. SCAN DETECTS A POWERED FABRICATION FOUNDRY IN SECTOR 9.
texts.code.mothership.9fdeb72944: MOTHERSHIP: COARDS UPLOADED TO THE COMPASS. GO AND LOCATE THAT FOUNDRY FOR GEAR PRINTING.
texts.code.system.a298dd132b: SYSTEM: O₂ FIELD ACTIVE. STABILIZER SHIELD ENGAGED.
texts.code.mothership.383f1ac17e: MOTHERSHIP: TANK UNIT. LONG-RANGE SCANNER HAS RETRIEVED FABRICATOR SIGNAL COARDS.
texts.code.mothership.75af1b93bc: MOTHERSHIP: WE NEED THAT PRINTING STATION OPERATIONAL. LOCATE THE FOUNDRY IMMEDIATELY.
texts.code.system.936495759f: SYSTEM: O₂ GRID ONLINE. POWER DISTRIBUTED TO BASE FIXTURES.
texts.code.mothership.fe8846384e: MOTHERSHIP: ENGINEER. AN ACTIVE FABRICATOR SIGNAL HAS BEEN INTERCEPTED NEARBY.
texts.code.mothership.3a983c43de: MOTHERSHIP: FAB BAY ACCESSIBLE VIA IN-WORLD FOUNDRY. FOLLOW THE RADAR COMPASS EDGE.
texts.code.system.950fd2231c: SYSTEM: HULL INTEGRITY EXPANDED. STRUCTURAL CAPACITY INCREASED.
texts.code.mothership.e728e15fd3: MOTHERSHIP: CRYOGENIC SHIELDING IS OPERATIONAL. A RETALIATION SIGNATURE IS APPROACHING.
texts.code.system.9136bff0b2: SYSTEM: HEAVY SHIP PLATING ENGAGED. STRUCTURAL CAPACITY INCREASED.
texts.code.mothership.8e252c0eb0: MOTHERSHIP: HULL ENHANCEMENTS COMPLETE. A CRYOGENIC RETALIATION SIGNATURE IS APPROACHING.
texts.code.system.8dc2681eb9: SYSTEM: BULKHEAD INTEGRATION STABILIZED. STRUCTURAL CAPACITY INCREASED.
texts.code.mothership.5c6e271bef: MOTHERSHIP: HULL BAY IS ONLINE. A CRYOGENIC RETALIATION SIGNATURE IS APPROACHING.
texts.code.system.4e23eeb73e: SYSTEM: SCANNER MAST ONLINE. RADAR FIELD ESTABLISHED.
texts.code.mothership.ad7d0f5971: MOTHERSHIP: BIOTIC ZONE READINGS UPLOADED. A RETALIATION SIGNATURE IS CLOSING IN.
texts.code.system.c9f35ea5dd: SYSTEM: RADAR ANTENNA ENGAGED. SIGNAL RETRIEVAL OPTIMIZED.
texts.code.mothership.9d616313d2: MOTHERSHIP: SCANNER MAST IS ONLINE. A RETALIATION SIGNATURE IS CLOSING IN.
texts.code.system.ae8dfea944: SYSTEM: UPLINK TERMINAL SYNCHRONIZED. RADAR TRANSMITTER ACTIVE.
texts.code.mothership.e44318ceeb: MOTHERSHIP: RADAR MATRIX LOCKED. A RETALIATION SIGNATURE IS CLOSING IN.
texts.code.system.e95fc1ce0e: SYSTEM: REACTOR COMPRESSOR ACTIVE. POWER GRID STABILIZED.
texts.code.mothership.f498200700: MOTHERSHIP: FINAL SYSTEM REBOOT COMMENCING. DEFEND THE WRECK.
texts.code.mothership.669494d7fd: MOTHERSHIP: ...WAIT. THE CORE READS INCOMPLETE. ONE COMPONENT IS STILL MISSING.
texts.code.system.ba82235034: SYSTEM: DEEP STRUCTURE SIGNAL LOCKED, FAR PAST THE BIO SECTOR. COORDINATES ON THE FIELD COMPASS.
texts.code.system.e0f59d236d: SYSTEM: POWER REACTOR GRID ENGAGED. FULL SHIELD ENERGY RESTORED.
texts.code.mothership.815d6b7398: MOTHERSHIP: POWER COMPRESSOR STABILIZED. DEFEND THE WRECK.
texts.code.mothership.a3582eadb8: MOTHERSHIP: ...HOLD. CORE MANIFEST INCOMPLETE. ONE COMPONENT IS STILL MISSING.
texts.code.system.22ca4d46d4: SYSTEM: COMPRESSOR CONTROL ACTIVE. POWER CHANNELS SYNCHRONIZED.
texts.code.mothership.39d2482e29: MOTHERSHIP: REACTOR AUXILIARY ONLINE. DEFEND THE WRECK.
texts.code.mothership.29e75698f7: MOTHERSHIP: ...ANOMALY. CORE CHECKSUM FAILS — ONE COMPONENT IS STILL MISSING.
texts.code.briggs.c41a5e68a5: BRIGGS: Word from Sector 9: you put the roach mayor down. Good riddance. A monster wearing an election button is still a monster.
texts.code.briggs.8486c89db0: BRIGGS: What in God's name did you do?! My scouts say Tina is still walking—and she's whispering in your head. Keep that thing far away from Vesper.
texts.code.briggs.c4f4e96b98: BRIGGS: You let that monstrosity crawl away? The doctor's bleeding-heart research will get us all torn apart, Operator.
texts.code.briggs.4c5300de82: BRIGGS: Good kill. The doctor can cry into her Petri dishes; that's one less set of jaws pacing our perimeter.
texts.code.briggs.44014c3a71: BRIGGS: You signed the Queen's pact?! Two berths on the shuttle for that abomination?! You're leaving my squad to suffocate in the ice!
texts.code.briggs.75b7fb944d: BRIGGS: You stood before the Brood Mother and told her to burn. Now THAT is soldiering, Operator. Vesper stands with you to the launchpad.
texts.code.briggs.660c219b3a: BRIGGS: Vesper garrison stands relieved and combat-ready. You honored your word to a soldier, Operator. I won't forget it.
texts.code.briggs.eaaa1fd1da: BRIGGS: So that's how it is. You cut our supply line and left Vesper to the frost. Watch your back out in the dark.
texts.code.briggs.ee5236f19f: BRIGGS: Sister Martha's radio beacon just lit up the sector. Every survivor knows there's hope—and every swarm knows our coordinates.
texts.code.briggs.793d69e752: BRIGGS: Tallow's radio went dark. Cold calculus, Operator, but quiet boots keep the swarm from converging on the escape roads.
texts.code.briggs.3474b8ca40: BRIGGS: Kaelen published the true shuttle manifest. No corporate favoritism, no hidden VIP slots. Straight shooting. I respect that.
texts.code.briggs.dad23e70dc: BRIGGS: Kaelen's manifest numbers don't add up. Someone is doctoring the passenger rolls. If my squad got cut, we're going to have words.
texts.code.briggs.46e36e6cc1: BRIGGS: Biometric sweep confirms your infection halted. You're pure human again, soldier. Let's finish this operation clean.
texts.code.briggs.dd60d39048: BRIGGS: What did Nahl stitch into your veins?! Your vitals are spiking alien enzymes. Keep your distance from my barricades.
texts.code.briggs.db3b45e995: BRIGGS: Heavy static on tactical comms! The Relay Hive jammed human radio! We're blind on the trench perimeters!
texts.code.briggs.2b70d0df28: BRIGGS: The radio static cleared into... thoughts? I can feel the swarm's flanks shifting. Wild tech, Operator. Use it to keep us alive.
texts.code.briggs.e655154faf: BRIGGS: The Carapace colossus pledged itself to the Queen. We'll have to pierce three inches of bio-armor if that beast blocks our landing.
texts.code.briggs.cdf781ea8a: BRIGGS: That walking fortress Rhun is shielding your advance? Ha! I wouldn't mind a beast like that anchoring our frontline.
texts.code.martha.ef29ea0ea8: MARTHA: We heard about Mayor Tina. God forgive us... but at least the transit tunnels between our camps are quiet tonight.
texts.code.martha.598d7b9e53: MARTHA: Operator... the air smells like sweet mold from the deep shaft. Tina's bio-signature is following you. May heaven have mercy on what you've welcomed in.
texts.code.martha.8b9e8b55ab: MARTHA: Okonkwo-Vass wept over the comms. She said you held your fire and it listened. Maybe there is still a spark of grace left in this dark.
texts.code.martha.a102727296: MARTHA: You crushed it right in front of her... Vass went dark on the frequencies. When hope dies in a scholar, it leaves a terrible silence.
texts.code.martha.92ed42f678: MARTHA: The Queen's brood is boarding... We can smell the royal spores through the air scrubbers. How could you trade our salvation for monsters?
texts.code.martha.1e956f8335: MARTHA: You turned your back on the Queen's temptation. Our prayers were answered. We will make our pilgrimage to the ship as human souls.
texts.code.martha.ad08fe1a06: MARTHA: Commander Briggs broadcast the defense pact. Knowing Vesper's shields are holding our perimeter lets Tallow sleep tonight.
texts.code.martha.fc768284e1: MARTHA: Vesper's radio is screaming... You abandoned Briggs's garrison? If the Commander falls, who protects the outer rim?
texts.code.martha.28727f4a02: MARTHA: Our beacon is singing into the ice! Every lost soul in the tunnels can hear our choir guiding them to safety.
texts.code.martha.99b100ef4c: MARTHA: We cut the transmission cables. Our voices are silenced... Pray that our quiet footsteps lead us through the valley unharmed.
texts.code.martha.207c65f0f5: MARTHA: Overseer Kaelen told the truth about the shuttle seats. Transparency is bitter, but honesty cleanses the spirit.
texts.code.martha.5c101bd89f: MARTHA: Whispers are spreading that the passenger manifest was forged. Fear and suspicion will tear our camps apart before the frost does.
texts.code.martha.1832227825: MARTHA: The plague marks receded from your skin! Praise be—the flesh can be redeemed even in the deep dark.
texts.code.martha.57c4323c50: MARTHA: You let the Suture stitch their spore into your blood... You walk between two worlds now, Operator.
texts.code.martha.e137d08830: MARTHA: Our prayer frequencies are drowned in shrieking feedback. The hive chorus has severed our link to the other sanctuaries.
texts.code.martha.1f288af536: MARTHA: The static in the headset... it sounds like singing. Vey opened their minds to us. It is terrifying, yet holy.
texts.code.martha.25f52d1b69: MARTHA: The great armored beast knelt before the brood mother. The ancient covenants are reforming beneath the frost.
texts.code.martha.0f7488e430: MARTHA: A giant of chitin and stone has sworn to protect you. May its heavy shell shelter your humanity to the journey's end.
texts.code.kaelen.b1fc42ad14: KAELEN: Transmission log confirmed: Tina's neural pulse flatlined. Tragic loss of pre-collapse civic data, but necessary for sector containment.
texts.code.kaelen.b5873a31e2: KAELEN: Sensor spike in your suit's auxiliary core. Tina's frequency didn't terminate—it merged with yours. The math on your humanity index is plummeting.
texts.code.kaelen.ff3c616181: KAELEN: Telemetry verified: the specimen ceased hostile vibrations and withdrew. Fascinating acoustic damping. Perhaps synthesis is more than theory.
texts.code.kaelen.fc6e384fa8: KAELEN: Biological subject liquidated. Vass has ceased log transmissions. Efficient, but we just lost our best translator for the deep hive.
texts.code.kaelen.a1a811d1c8: KAELEN: Biological mass overload in Launch Bay 3. Queen alien secured in secondary hold. Our evacuation capacity has been halved. God help us in orbit.
texts.code.kaelen.df6bf22474: KAELEN: Neural lure decoupled. The Queen has retreated into the trench magma. Vessel berths remain clear for civilian manifests.
texts.code.kaelen.a85e642b38: KAELEN: Briggs's tactical perimeter is online. Power fluctuations stabilized across the foundry conduits. Good work securing Vesper.
texts.code.kaelen.85d8b0a76e: KAELEN: Distress signals from Camp Vesper went dark. Strategic defense matrix compromised. Meridian is running on emergency reserve.
texts.code.kaelen.efb02ae9fa: KAELEN: High-frequency civilian broadcast detected from Camp Tallow. Frequencies locked. Guiding refugees toward rendezvous.
texts.code.kaelen.d15b9f7157: KAELEN: Signal dampeners deployed at Tallow. Civilian broadcast killed. Stealth parameters preserved at cost of civilian morale.
texts.code.kaelen.769f4d5aa7: KAELEN: Authentic vessel logs compiled and distributed. Every seat accounted for. No more corporate secrets between us.
texts.code.kaelen.3955703b44: KAELEN: Manifest encrypted and modified. Certain cargo must remain off the official record. I hope you can live with the delta.
texts.code.kaelen.aaf7fb5ca0: KAELEN: Bio-telemetry normal. Pathogen neutralized. Launch quarantine clearance granted without restrictions.
texts.code.kaelen.ba56d1f40c: KAELEN: Symbiotic bond stabilized. You are now a carrier organism. External quarantine seals will be required at launch.
texts.code.kaelen.a8f434794f: KAELEN: Human comms band suppressed by acoustic dampening. Only encrypted hive channels remain open.
texts.code.kaelen.6447ed8d44: KAELEN: Direct psychic-radio bridge operational. Sensor latency reduced by 94%. We can hear the swarm thinking.
texts.code.kaelen.1f27ef7675: KAELEN: Kinetic field diverted to the Brood Mother. Defensive telemetry re-routed away from human shuttle access.
texts.code.kaelen.65fa8dde74: KAELEN: Kinetic deflection field projected by Carapace unit Rhun. Exosuit survivability increased exponentially.
texts.code.tina.3feffd2653: TINA: (chittering softly) The little snail remembered the warm burrow... Vass sees the music now, doesn't she, neighbor?
texts.code.tina.e11ca04ef7: TINA: (clicking) You crushed the shell... Just like the Council used to crush housing variances. Old habits die cold.
texts.code.tina.0e67a7d67e: TINA: Mother is coming home to the sky with us! Feel the thrum in the pipes, dear? We won't need heat lamps where we're going.
texts.code.tina.8e234aabfe: TINA: (hissing) You left Her in the sludge?! After everything She spun for you?! The vents will remember this, Operator...
texts.code.tina.3c75eec21e: TINA: The soldier built his pretty walls. Chitin grows right over rebar, dear, but let him have his parade.
texts.code.tina.c20ec7c95e: TINA: Vesper is going dark... More fertilizer for the mushroom gardens. The municipal budget balances itself.
texts.code.tina.de144b1ac8: TINA: Martha's voice is ringing like church bells! It tickles my antennae all the way down in the coolant tanks.
texts.code.tina.01bf8878d5: TINA: Silence is so peaceful, isn't it? No elections, no petitions. Just the spore dusting over the quiet floor.
texts.code.tina.55885c8a0b: TINA: The engineer printed the guest list! Did he save a seat under the floorboards for the Mayor?
texts.code.tina.b5a98c7942: TINA: (chuckling) Doctoring the paperwork! You really DO have what it takes for city politics, Operator.
texts.code.tina.4c2d13321e: TINA: (whimpering) You burned the spore out?! It was so warm, Operator... Why would you want to be cold and lonely again?
texts.code.tina.6666d01df5: TINA: (purring) Yes... feel the tendrils knitting under your ribs. Welcome to the committee, sister.
texts.code.tina.bcf0f5ee77: TINA: Vey's song is in your skull now too! Isn't the harmony lovely? We'll never have to speak through tin cans again.
texts.code.tina.ad8bbac826: TINA: Big brother Rhun has your back. He's slow, but he crushes things that get between friends.
texts.code.mothership.aa07aebade: MOTHERSHIP: CARRIER TELEMETRY LOST. SIGNAL JAMMED. CORRECTION: UNPOWERED.
texts.code.mothership.03d8d2ff47: MOTHERSHIP: NO VOICE DETECTED ON SYSTEM UPLINK. SENDING EXTERMINATOR SCAN.
texts.code.mothership.78ba702ccf: MOTHERSHIP: UNAUTHORIZED SHIELD EMISSION DETECTED. ORBITAL SENSORS LOCKING.
texts.code.mothership.aad6eb7777: MOTHERSHIP: SURVEY SIGNAL DETECTS PATHOGEN PROFILE IN SURVIVOR ZONES.
texts.code.mothership.533c46d701: MOTHERSHIP: AGENT CLASSIFIED AS VECTOR-ALPHA. HOSTILE ENGAGEMENT GRANTED.
texts.code.mothership.aea17fe99e: MOTHERSHIP: ORBITAL EXTERMINATION LANDER LAUNCHED. RECOVERY ABANDONED.
texts.code.mothership.b5ee31fcd3: MOTHERSHIP: DETECTING BIO-SYNAPTIC RESONANCE. AGENT BRAIN-DEATH PROBABLE.
texts.code.mothership.a9628a4afc: MOTHERSHIP: CORRUPT TRANSMISSION DETECTED. SOURCE: SPECIMEN-0047.
texts.code.mothership.be056763a9: MOTHERSHIP: WEAPON PAYLOAD ARMED. DO NOT RESIST THE PURGE.
texts.code.mothership.a5d6a5ea95: MOTHERSHIP: LAUNCH DETECTED. VECTOR OUT OF SECURE CHANNELS. FIRE CODES READY.
texts.code.tina.a01eb480b8: MAYOR TINA: YOU SHOULD HAVE LEFT WELL ENOUGH ALONE!
texts.code.tina.74118f9de7: MAYOR TINA: THE PROTOCOL WILL EXECUTE YOU!
texts.code.tina.4cf1e8d1a9: TEACUP SIREN: HEY, HOTSHOT. THE MAYOR IS TAKING VISITORS.
texts.code.tina.5e40d44057: TEACUP SIREN: NICE EXOSUIT, STRANGER. COME CLOSER.
texts.code.tina.86217248ed: TEACUP SIREN: PSST. YES, YOU. MAYOR TINA SAVED YOU A SEAT.
texts.code.tina.c3f8f320ce: TEACUP SIREN: LOOKING VERY MAYORAL, YOUR HONOR.
texts.code.mothership.c069fdb7f9: MOTHERSHIP: DEFEAT THE CORRUPTED OPERATOR TO SECURE THE BLACK BOX.
texts.code.mothership.4c2e9ca25a: MOTHERSHIP: CAUTION. RECOVERY SIGNATURE TRACKED. PATROLS INBOUND.
texts.code.tina.489fdccca3: MAYOR TINA: PUT THAT DOWN. I AM ASKING ONCE.
texts.code.tina.eff9746215: MAYOR TINA: A SCRATCH. IS THAT YOUR BEST?
texts.code.tina.626d843cae: MAYOR TINA: YOU ARE COMMITTED NOW, OPERATIVE!
texts.code.tina.e6d5cb4473: MAYOR TINA: THE BUNKER DOES NOT FORGIVE!
